name: Dustyn
bio: Singing since 2016. Dustyn found his voice in a jam room at the Gary Job Corps rec center, after watching another guy botch “Smells Like Teen Spirit” and deciding to take a crack at it himself. He cut his teeth in a nameless cover band in Arkansas before taking the mic for ETA.

name: Darrel
bio: Rocking since 1989, Darrel has played in numerous punk and metal bands throughout his career. He's the co-founder of ETA along with Scott, and is known for his Iceman guitars, loud overdriven Marshalls, and Adrenaline Pumping Riffs.

name: Scott
bio: Co-founder of ETA, known for his high energy and his tendency to break drum sticks, Scott is an absolute animal behind the kit and the heartbeat of the band.

name: Gedy
bio: Darrel's son, Gedy is our ultra-chill but loveable bass player, always holding down the low end.
